Card geometry and typography are visually matched, not a pixel-perfect reproduction. Exact 707×1121 title baseline and bottom margin await technical processing.
The lane has a gentle bend and distant arch rather than a strong winding S-curve; short distant segment appears straight.
There are two main ground rugs, two small figures, and simple side awnings. Fine wares and architecture are interpreted generatively.
Early-morning reading is conveyed by low warm light, cool shadows and azure sky; time of day is an artistic interpretation.
Ability uses thin regular serif and title bold resembling originals, but exact font-family or metric match is not claimed.
